corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez imperative plural of ዐቀበ (Matthew 6:1) is clearly ዑቁ ('Take heed'), where the 2nd-order strokes on ዑ and ቁ were misread as ዕቀ.
The causative perfect verb in Matthew 21:14 is ወአምጽኡ ('and they brought'), printed with 1st-order አ rather than 6th-order እ.
Removed duplicate four-dot punctuation mark at the end of the line.
